---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool or capability for the Linnworks MCP server
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'feature-request'
assignees: ''
---

## What question do you want to ask Claude?

_Describe the business question or task this would enable. Be specific — "show me revenue by channel this month" is more useful than "reporting tool"._

## What Linnworks data is involved?

_Which area(s) of Linnworks does this touch? e.g. processed orders, open orders, inventory, purchase orders, rules engine, imports/exports._

## Why can't the existing tools answer this?

_Check the tool list in README.md first. If something close exists but falls short, explain what's missing._

## Expected output

_What should Claude return? e.g. a ranked list, a summary dict, a yes/no with reason. Rough is fine._

## Any other context

_Screenshots, example data shapes, links to relevant Linnworks API docs — anything that helps._

---

> **Note:** Feature requests are reviewed by the maintainer before any work begins.
> You'll see an `approved` label added if it's accepted, or a comment explaining why not.
> Please don't submit pull requests for new features without an approved issue first.
